fusions.name: Lazy Current
fusions.desc: Pushes a slow current in a cone 4 tiles long that deals 3 water damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each [Weakened] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Broadside Bump
fusions.desc: A heavy bump that deals 13 water damage, knocks the target 3 tiles back and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Floating Rest
fusions.desc: Restores 20 health to you, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Catching Breath
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full again, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
